content.title: 2026 New York Yankees schedule: How to watch on Prime Video
content.text: NewsEntertainmentSelect New York Yankees games will be available for local Prime members to stream during the 2026 MLB season.Last updated: April 08, 20263 min readKey takeawaysPrime members in New York, Connecticut, north and central New Jersey and northeast Pennsylvania can stream 21 free New York Yankees games this season.17 of the 21 games will air on Wednesday evenings.YES Network and Prime Video Sports will produce the broadcasts, with play-by-play broadcaster Michael Kay returning for a 35th season.Prime Video is streaming 21 New York Yankees games this season for free for Prime members in New York State, Connecticut, north and central New Jersey, and northeast Pennsylvania.The Prime Video slate includes highly anticipated clashes throughout the season, including two games each against Detroit and Cleveland—both 2025 AL playoff teams—plus three games against division rival Baltimore and two against Tampa Bay.Here are all the Yankees games streaming on Prime Video this season:Which Yankees games will be on Prime Video?There will be 21 Yankees streamed live on Prime Video during the 2026 MLB regular season, 17 of which will be on Wednesday nights. All games times will be in EDT and subject to change.Wednesday, April 8: Athletics at New York Yankees—7:05 p.m.Wednesday, April 15: Los Angeles Angels at New York Yankees—7:05 p.m.Wednesday, April 22: New York Yankees at Boston Red Sox—6:45 p.m.Tuesday, April 28: New York Yankees at Texas Rangers—8:05 p.m.Wednesday, May 6: Texas Rangers at New York Yankees—7:05 p.m.Wednesday, May 13: New York Yankees at Baltimore Orioles—6:35 p.m.Wednesday, May 20: Toronto Blue Jays at New York Yankees—7:05 p.m.Wednesday, May 27: New York Yankees at Kansas City Royals—7:40 p.m.Wednesday, June 3: Cleveland Guardians at New York Yankees—7:05 p.m.Tuesday, June 9: New York Yankees at Cleveland Guardians—6:40 p.m.Wednesday, June 17: Chicago White Sox at New York Yankees—7:05 p.m.Wednesday, June 24: New York Yankees at Detroit Tigers—6:40 p.m.Tuesday, June 30: Detroit Tigers at New York Yankees—7:05 p.m.Wednesday July 8: New York Yankees at Tampa Bay Rays—6:40 p.m.Wednesday, July 29: New York Yankees at Chicago White Sox—7:40 p.m.Wednesday, August 5: St. Louis Cardinals at New York Yankees—7:05 p.m.Wednesday, August 19: New York Yankees at Baltimore Orioles—6:35 p.m.Thursday, August 20: New York Yankees at Baltimore Orioles—6:35 p.m.Wednesday, August 26: Houston Astros at New York Yankees—7:05 p.m.Wednesday, September 9: Colorado Rockies at New York Yankees—7:05 p.m.Wednesday, September 23: Tampa Bay Rays at New York Yankees—7:05 p.m.How to watch Yankees games on Prime VideoIt’s very easy to watch Yankees games on Prime Video. As mentioned, you’ll need to live in New York State, Connecticut, north and central New Jersey, or northeast Pennsylvania to see the game.Assuming you do, all you need to do is open up the Prime Video app on your smart TV, phone, tablet, or other compatible device. You can also watch Prime Video from your desktop.Prime Video is included with a Prime membership, priced at $14.99 a month or $139 a year. Amazon also offers discounted memberships through Prime Access, aimed at those benefiting from certain government assistance programs—and Prime for young adults, for those enrolled in higher education and/or between the ages of 18 and 24.You can also try out Prime with a free trial.Prime Video’s live Yankees games will be available to MLB.TV subscribers outside the Yankees’ home-team footprint.Full Yankees coverage on Prime VideoPrime Video’s 30-minute pregame show is also back. YES’s Bob Lorenz serves as the main host and Justin Shackil will fill in for select games. Meredith Marakovits will handle reporting duties and provide on-site insights and live interviews from the field.YES Network play-by-play announcer Michael Kay will once again be behind the mic for Prime Video’s Yankees in-game coverage. Entering his 35th year as the voice of the storied franchise, Kay will be joined by YES analysts David Cone, Paul O’Neill, and former Yankees manager Joe Girardi.Yankees games on Prime Video will showcase live in-game stats, team and player details, and real-time play-by-play accounts for fans streaming on Android, iOS mobile, and Fire TV.What else can I watch on Prime Video?When the game is done, there are tons of other things you can tune into on Prime Video, such as other live sports and original series, and movies.Fantasy fans will want to take a look at The Lord of the Rings: The Rings of Power, while action fans should check out Reacher, Cross, and Fallout.Members can also stream programming from partners such as Apple TV, HBO Max, Crunchyroll, and MGM+ via Prime Video Subscriptions as well as more than 900 free ad-supported (FAST) Channels.Next, learn how to use Prime Video's "Shop the Show" feature to discover products from your favorite series, movies, and live sports.Sign up for the weekly Amazon newsletterSign up for the latest news, facts, analysis, and original stories about Amazon, delivered to you weekly.This story has been updated to reflect the full 2026 Yankees schedule on Prime Video.
